title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards — Schedule of Card Kinds
content:
Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards are issued in six kinds. Every kind is one card number holding its own balance, and the kinds differ in physical form, in how a card comes into existence, in whether it is sold for money, and in whose name it is issued. All six kinds carry a card number of 16 digits.

## Schedule

| Rank | Card kind | Form | How the card comes into existence | Sold for money | Issued in the name of | Card number |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Plastic | Purchase | Yes | The bearer | 16 digits |
| 2 | Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | Digital | Purchase | Yes | The recipient email address | 16 digits |
| 3 | Merchandise Credit Card | Plastic | Store issue | No | The returning customer | 16 digits |
| 4 | Registry Reward Card | Digital | Store issue | No | The registrant | 16 digits |
| 5 | Corporate Gift Card | Plastic | Corporate order | Yes | The bearer | 16 digits |
| 6 | Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | Plastic | Promotion | No | The purchasing customer | 16 digits |

The rank is the order in which the six kinds are listed in the Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards family.

## Entry terms of each kind

- **Marlowe & Finch Gift Card** — obtained by purchase, with a load of at least $10.00.
- **Marlowe & Finch eGift Card** — obtained by purchase, with a load of at least $10.00, and a recipient email address is required.
- **Merchandise Credit Card** — issued by the store, for one of three reasons only: a return refund, a registry credit conversion, or an alteration damage settlement.
- **Registry Reward Card** — issued by the store for one reason only: registry rewards.
- **Corporate Gift Card** — obtained through a corporate order of at least 10 cards per order.
- **Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card** — obtained through a promotion, earned by a qualifying purchase of at least $100.00.

## Reading the schedule

- *Which kinds can a customer buy?* Three kinds are sold for money: the Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, the Marlowe & Finch eGift Card and the Corporate Gift Card. The Merchandise Credit Card, the Registry Reward Card and the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card are never sold; they come into existence only by store issue or by promotion.
- *Which kinds exist only in digital form?* The Marlowe & Finch eGift Card and the Registry Reward Card. The other four kinds are plastic cards.
- *Whose name is on a store-issued card?* A Merchandise Credit Card is issued in the name of the returning customer, and a Registry Reward Card in the name of the registrant. A Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card is issued in the name of the purchasing customer.
- *What identifies a card?* Its 16-digit card number, printed on a plastic card or carried in the eGift email for a digital one.

### Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical caller holds a plastic card that was never paid for and was handed over at a returns counter. On this schedule the only plastic, store-issued kind is the Merchandise Credit Card, issued in the returning customer's name.
